status_note: 3d-model-pipeline stage 7a (pilot 2026-10-14): UE import of the Angel look-dev run 20261013-h2-lookdev (profile angel-h2-lookdev/1: generic h2_bake H2 figure + UV1 in metres, MatID, Edge, graded BC/ORM) through the CLI profile skeletal-adopt (normaliser h2-lookdev/1) onto the canonical skeleton /Game/PipelineCandidates/Angel/Rig/SK_Angel_Skeleton. MI of /Game/UM/Materials/v2/M_UM_Figure_v2 (UseTeamAccent, UseUV1Metres) with the TeamAccent mask of the run 20261013-h2-lookdev-teamaccent-b (profile /1b, P3-4a; mask byte-identical to /1) and the look-dev LUT as is (UE look-dev iteration 0); base on M_UM_BaseMarker. Teams = the active C-11 palette P1 #E8C06A / P2 #5A7F9F (user decision 'accents + ring'). At most 'technically imported'; art acceptance of the model by delegation (stage 4 r1 pass 8.8, evidence/acceptance/20261013-r1/card.json). Rev 2 (UE look-dev r2, 2026-10-14): only the hero LUT changes (20261014-h2ld-ldc-ue/lut/T_UM_MatLUT_Angel_UE_r2: leather specular 0.5 -> 0.3, leather_smooth roughness 0.37 -> 0.5, silk sheen 0.5 -> 0.15); r1 frames had the dark classes 2-3.4x brighter than the concept from specular/sheen on near-black albedo. Re-import by references/ue-import-package.md §4.4 (assets of 20261014-h2ld-ue-import deleted by script, new run 20261014-h2ld-ue-import-r2). Rev 3 (UE look-dev r3, the last light-mode iteration): LUT T_UM_MatLUT_Angel_UE_r3 (leather specular 0.2, leather_smooth roughness 0.58, leather_worn roughness 0.55, silk sheen 0.06 / specular 0.25); re-import by §4.4 into run 20261014-h2ld-ue-import-r3.
